text:
Maria (PM): quick sync — we need to define the audit-evidence packaging+ops runbook for enterprise SOC2/ISO requests. what exactly do we hand customers vs what stays internal?
Sanjay (Security): high level: evidence bundle should contain signed hashes of log files, key metadata (kms key id, wrap algorithm), and an integrity manifest. customers often ask for chain-of-custody notes.
Kevin (Eng Infra): agree. also need API + S3 export pattern. re: format, parquet for bulk, csv for quick views. presigned URLs ok for downloads.
Priya (CS): two large customers asked for nightly per-tenant exports with 30/90/365 retention tiers. they want delivery confirmation within 24h.
Chloe (Legal): legal-hold requests: retention lockdown must override deletion and we need an audit trail showing hold start/stop + owner. include export of hold metadata in bundle.
Maria (PM): good. propose acceptance criteria for MVP: 1) evidence bundle schema documented, 2) export API (tenant-scoped) + S3 presigned delivery, 3) runbook for on-call to re-generate bundles, 4) manifest signed by platform key, 5) retention/hold controls enforced. thoughts?
Sanjay (Security): add: proof-of-delivery signature (we should log a receipt event and cryptographic hash of bundle). also include KMS envelope metadata in manifest so customer can verify BYOK handling.
Kevin (Eng Infra): ops constraints: we need a background job that zips + signs, and a rate limiter per-tenant to avoid spikes. propose async job with idempotency key. sample endpoint: POST /v1/tenants/:id/audit_exports {period:start,end,format:parquet|csv} -> returns job_id.
Priya (CS): customers will want notifications to their webhook/email when ready. can we include webhook callback + retry policy?
Maria (PM): yes — add webhook_url (opt-in) and status callbacks. retries: exponential up to 3 attempts, then human on-call alert.
Sanjay (Security): BYOK: if customer supplies key material, we must include key fingerprint + wrap metadata. avoid shipping unwrapped keys. note: for key escrow/escrow proposals we need legal sign-off.
Chloe (Legal): ack. we need checkbox in contract for escrow vs customer-managed keys. also require SLA clause for evidence delivery and liability caps.
Kevin (Eng Infra): implementation note: store intermediate artifacts in cold tier (30 days) to allow quick re-gen, then archive. cost estimates needed for retention>90d.
Maria (PM): timeline idea: 2-week spec + 3-week implementation of API + internal runbook, then 1-week canary with 2 pilot customers.
Priya (CS): can commit 2 pilots from accounts team. will coordinate.
Sanjay (Security): quick schema snippet example (for manifest):
```
manifest_v1: {
  tenant_id: "abc",
  period: "2026-02-01:2026-02-28",
  files: [{path: "logs/part-000.parquet", sha256: "...", size: 12345}],
  kms: {key_id: "projects/..../key", wrap_algo: "RSA-OAEP-256"},
  signed_by: "platform-signing-key-v2",
}
```
Kevin (Eng Infra): + ops snippet:
```
POST /v1/tenants/abc/audit_exports
body: {start, end, format, webhook_url}
-> 202 {job_id}
GET /v1/jobs/{job_id} -> {status, download_url}
```
Maria (PM): ok we need a short-runbook doc for oncall: steps to re-run job, escalate sequence, how to validate manifest signatures, and how to hand off to legal for subpoena/hold. can someone draft?
Kevin (Eng Infra): I can draft runbook ops steps.
Chloe (Legal): I'll add legal escalation steps + contract checklist.
Priya (CS): I'll prepare pilot acceptance checklist from customer side (delivery timing, integrity verification, webhook handling).
Sanjay (Security): one more: search SLA. customers ask for ability to search events in exports within 48h. we can commit to export availability within 24h and search index availability within 48h for enterprise tier only.
Maria (PM): note taken. add to acceptance criteria: export availability <=24h, indexability <=48h (enterprise).
infra-bot: new doc created: https://redwood-internal.prod/docs/audit-evidence-packaging (created by Maria)
Priya (CS): can we add an example verification script for customers to validate bundle hashes? would reduce CS load.
Sanjay (Security): yes — small script that verifies sha256 of files and signature. I'll add to repo.
Maria (PM): great. next steps: Kevin spec + runbook draft by EOW, Sanjay - manifest+verify script, Chloe - contract language, Priya - pilot roster, me - consolidate spec and publish.
All: reactions: :thumbsup: :shipit:
